name: Hydrogen-rich water
short: Adverse events 27% vs 26.2% on placebo in a 675-person COVID-19 trial (deaths 1 vs 2); no severe events in 36 adults with obesity who drank it. Cited data do not cover bathing or capsules.
text: In a phase 3, triple-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial in 675 primary-care patients with mild-to-moderate COVID-19 who took hydrogen-rich water or placebo twice daily for 21 days, adverse events were reported in 91 (27%) and 89 (26.2%) participants respectively, and by day 30, 1 death was reported in the hydrogen group and 2 in the placebo group. In a multicentre, double-blind randomised trial in 50 people with type 2 diabetes, no treatment-related adverse effects of electrolysed hydrogen-rich water (compared with filtered water) were observed. In an open-label phase 2 study without a comparison group in 24 people with chronic graft-versus-host disease who took hydrogen-rich water by mouth, no significant toxicity was observed. In an 8-week randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial in 36 adults with obesity who drank hydrogen-rich water or control water daily, no severe adverse effects were reported; the abstract does not say whether milder adverse effects occurred. A 48-week randomised, double-blind pilot trial in people with Parkinson's disease taking levodopa (groups of 9 on hydrogen water and 8 on pseudo water) concluded that drinking hydrogen water was safe and well tolerated, but its abstract gives no adverse-event figures. In the 30-person interstitial cystitis trial of hydrogen-rich water, 2 participants were withdrawn, and the abstract gives neither the reasons nor any adverse-event data. The obesity and Parkinson's trials gave the water to drink and the graft-versus-host study gave it by mouth; the COVID-19 abstract says only that it was taken twice daily, and the diabetes and interstitial cystitis abstracts do not state the route. The cited sources do not cover bathing in hydrogen-rich water or hydrogen capsules. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
